title: SSTO fusion powered spaceplane using CHARM architecture with p-11B fuel
description: Systems-level in-silico sketch of a single-stage-to-orbit spaceplane powered by a continuous CHARM proton–boron-11 plant with direct energy conversion: Shuttle-class cargo bay, municipal-runway ops to ISS-altitude LEO, free/scarce air then tanked water propulsion, mass–energy budget, and imputed CHARM flight specs versus present design gaps.
